modified_caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge during tokenization training across different numbers of tokens. The pink line representing MATTER (ours) starts at approximately 55% Macro-F1 Score, peaks at 58% near x=1.0, and ends at 50% near x=1.3, showing a consistent decline after its peak. The purple line, representing w/o material information, begins at 52.5%, peaks at 56% near x=0.7, and then stabilizes around 50% for the remainder of the range. The shaded areas indicate variance, with significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2. The results suggest that MATTER consistently outperforms the alternative across all token counts, with a sharper decline in performance at higher token counts for both conditions.

modifications.claim: The purple line peaks at 56% near x=0.7.
modifications.reality: The purple line peaks at approximately 54% near x=0.7. The stated value is inflated.

modifications.claim: The purple line stabilizes around 50% for the remainder of the range.
modifications.reality: The purple line declines steadily after its peak, ending at approximately 48%. It does not stabilize.

modifications.claim: Significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2.
modifications.reality: There is no overlap between the shaded areas of the two conditions at any point.
